# Letta Agent Memory Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that works with Letta, the stateful-agent platform born from Berkeley's MemGPT research: create agents with persistent memory blocks, read and write memory, archive and recall conversation history, and manage agent state across sessions. Memory writes are confirmed by default — memory is long-lived and hard to audit later, so nothing gets written silently. Letta offers a usable free tier ($0 with bring-your-own API keys; the core server is also open-source and self-hostable), with paid plans from $20/month for heavier use. Uses a Letta API key, kept in Muse's secure vault. Draft: written from Letta's public docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. No secrets in the repo.
